questions.text: You will hear two friends talking about a computer game. What is the boy doing?
questions.text_cn: 你将听到两个朋友谈论一个电脑游戏。这个男孩在做什么？
questions.explanation: 原文: 'I guess what I'm saying is that I wasn't very impressed.' 解析: 男孩说他对这个游戏没有留下很深的印象，暗示他对这个游戏感到失望。

options.label: A
options.text: complaining about the price of the game

options.label: B
options.text: suggesting how the game could be improved

options.label: C
options.text: admitting that he finds the game disappointing
options.text_cn: 承认他觉得游戏令人失望

questions.text: You will hear two students talking about a history project for school. What does the girl need to do?
questions.text_cn: 你将听到两个学生谈论一个学校的历史项目。这个女孩需要做什么？
questions.explanation: 原文: 'Anyway, she's asked me to do something else.' 解析: 女孩说老师让她做其他的事情，所以她需要改变她选择的题目。

options.label: C
options.text: talk about her plan with someone else

questions.text: You will hear a boy talking to his friend about a tennis lesson. How does the boy feel?
questions.text_cn: 你将听到一个男孩和他的朋友谈论网球课。这个男孩感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 原文: 'By the end of the lesson, I was doing OK, though not nearly as well as I'd hoped.' 解析: 男孩说他做得还行，但没有达到他期望的那么好，表明他对他的进展感到失望。

options.label: B

questions.text: You will hear two friends talking about a chess club. Why has the girl stopped going there?
questions.text_cn: 你将听到两个朋友谈论一个象棋俱乐部。这个女孩为什么停止去那里？
questions.explanation: 原文: 'And she suggested she could help me with my game. The price she's charging isn't too bad so...' 解析: 女孩说她和邻居谈论了象棋，邻居提出可以帮助她，而且价格也不太贵，所以她停止去俱乐部，是因为她将接受邻居的辅导。

options.label: A

options.text_cn: 她不如其他玩家那么好。

options.label: B
options.text: It costs a lot to be a member.

options.label: C
options.text: Her neighbour will give her lessons.

questions.explanation: 原文: 'But because I live quite far away, it's nearly an hour on my bike and that's hard, especially in the winter.' 解析: 男孩说因为他住的很远，骑自行车要将近一个小时，这很辛苦，尤其是在冬天。因此，他开始乘坐校车，因为他觉得骑自行车太久了。

options.label: C
options.text_cn: 喜欢和他的朋友一起旅行。

questions.text: You will hear two students talking about the uniform at their school. What do they agree about wearing it?
questions.text_cn: 你将听到两个学生谈论他们学校的校服。他们同意穿校服的哪一点？
questions.explanation: 原文: 'Girl: But now I don't have to think about that, so I can get up much later than before. Boy: True, that's a positive thing. An extra half an hour!' 解析: 女孩说现在她不用考虑穿什么，所以她可以比以前起得晚得多。男孩同意说这是一个积极的事情，可以多睡半个小时。所以他们都认为穿校服使得早上准备上学更容易。

options.label: A
options.text: It makes people respect the school.

options.label: B
options.text: It makes everyone look the same.
options.text_cn: 它使每个人看起来都一样。

options.label: C
options.text: It makes getting ready for school easy.
options.text_cn: 它使准备上学变得容易。
